description.zh:
网站业务的域名。最多可查询5个网站业务域名。
> 域名必须已配置网站业务转发规则。您可以调用[DescribeDomains](~~91724~~)查询所有域名。
description.en:
The domain names of website services. You can specify up to 5 domain names.
> The domain names must have website configuration forwarding rules configured. You can call [DescribeDomains](~~91724~~) to query all domain names.

description.zh: DDoS高防实例在资源管理产品中所属的资源组ID。默认为空，即属于默认资源组。
description.en: The ID of the resource group to which the Anti-DDoS Pro or Anti-DDoS Premium instance belongs in Resource Management. This parameter is empty by default, which indicates that the instance belongs to the default resource group.

title.zh: 查询网站业务各防护功能的开关状态
title.en: Query the status of protection features for website services

example.unifiedCli: aliyun ddoscoo describe-web-cc-protect-switch --resource-group-id default --domains www.aliyun00.com --api-version 2020-01-01 --region cn-hangzhou
